description: 대전교통공사_지하철 역사 내 CCTV 이상행동 영상 샘플데이터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전교통공사. 도시철도 역사 내에서 빈번하게 발생하는 이상행동(전도사고, 실신, 심정지, 폭력, 강도, 역사 테러, 몰래카메라 등)에 대하여 이상행동 감지, 이상상황 판별을 통한 사회 범죄 예방을 위한 AI 학습용 데이터 구축과 AI 학습 모델 제시하기 위한 샘플데이터임 개발 알고리즘과 데이터셋을 통해 도시철도역내... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 대전교통공사. Its tags are 인공지능, CCTV, 도시철도 역사, 안전관리, 이상상황. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
